apexes.title: the whole band in one breath
apexes.fantasy: Every voice lifts the next.

vowed.taste: The allies within 3 hexes of him gain 5% more mana from everything.

passives.name: Grand Voice
passives.text: The allies within 3 hexes of him gain more mana from everything.

apex.text: Crescendo also makes each ally's next signature 30% stronger. Whenever any hero fires a signature, every hero gains 4 mana. The allies within 3 hexes of him still gain 5% more mana. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

signature.name: Crescendo
signature.text: The bell swells: the allies within 3 hexes of him gain a burst of mana, attack faster for a while, and their next signature is stronger.

passives.name: Grand Voice
passives.text: The allies within 3 hexes of him gain more mana from everything.

passives.name: Grand Chorus
passives.text: Whenever any hero fires a signature, every hero gains a little mana.

deed.text: Signatures his allies fire within 3 hexes of him

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 4 (rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-4c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Wellspring
apexes.title: the well that never runs dry
apexes.fantasy: Their bars overflow, and he keeps pouring.

vowed.taste: Every hero's bar holds up to 120% of its mana: past full, a signature spends one bar and keeps the rest.

passives.name: Wellspring
passives.text: Every other hero's bar holds up to 120% of its mana.

passives.name: Wellspring
passives.text: His own bar holds as much.

apex.text: Every hero's bar has no cap, and a signature is 1% stronger for every 2 mana it holds past full as it fires. Each signature an ally fires from past full makes Chorus's share 10% bigger for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

passives.name: Wellspring
passives.text: Every other hero's bar has no cap.

passives.name: Wellspring
passives.text: His own bar holds as much.

passives.name: Overflow
passives.text: Every hero's signature is stronger for the mana it holds past full as it fires.

passives.name: Overflow
passives.text: His own too.

passives.name: Chorus
passives.text: Each time he gains mana, the allies within 3 hexes of him gain half as much, and more for each signature his allies fire from past a full bar.

passives.name: Swell
passives.text: Each signature an ally fires from past a full bar makes Chorus's share bigger for the rest of the fight.

deed.text: Mana his team gains past full

_note: The rangers' support (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8e, path 2; phase 8 part 4, 8d-4b). Tailwind's bonuses are auras on every ally whose target stands 3 hexes away or more (UnitCondition target_beyond_hexes). First numbers.
name: Windcaller
title: the wind at their backs
fantasy: The wind carries his allies' shots and keeps the enemy off them.
placement: Behind the ranged allies, where the wind reaches them and the enemy has far to come.

vowed.taste: Tailwind: allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more attack 5% faster.

basic_attack.name: Toll
basic_attack.text: A ringing note at the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. Where most of his mana comes from.

passives.name: Tailwind
passives.text: Allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more attack a little faster.

transformed.text: Tailwind stays. High Wind: allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more deal 20% more damage, and their shots fly 50% faster. Gale replaces Peal: it knocks every enemy within 2 hexes of each ranged ally 2 hexes back. Peal becomes a habit, every 8th Toll, for ranged allies. His MGK and HP rise.
transformed.cost: Peal and Resonance no longer reach melee allies.

signature.name: Gale
signature.text: A gust round each ranged ally: every enemy within 2 hexes of one is knocked back.

passives.name: Resonance
passives.text: The ranged allies within 2 hexes of him attack a little faster.

passives.name: Tailwind
passives.text: Allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more attack a little faster.

passives.name: High Wind
passives.text: Allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more deal more damage.

passives.name: High Wind
passives.text: Allies attacking an enemy 3 hexes away or more shoot faster shots.

passives.name: Peal
passives.text: A habit: every 8th Toll, the bell peals: the ranged allies within 3 hexes of him attack faster for a while.

deed.text: Hits his allies land from 3 hexes away or more under Tailwind

apexes.name: Long Wind
apexes.title: the wind that carries every shot
apexes.fantasy: The farther the shot, the harder it lands.

vowed.taste: Ranged allies deal 1% more damage for each hex between them and their target.

passives.name: Long Wind
passives.text: Ranged allies deal a little more damage for each hex to the enemy they hit.

passives.name: Long Wind
passives.text: His own hits too.

apex.text: Ranged allies deal 4% more damage for each hex between them and their target. Each kill by a ranged hero from 3 hexes or more gives every ranged hero +8% damage for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

passives.name: Long Wind
passives.text: Ranged allies deal more damage for each hex to the enemy they hit.

passives.name: Long Wind
passives.text: His own hits too.

passives.name: Gust
passives.text: Each kill by a ranged hero from 3 hexes or more gives every ranged hero more damage for the rest of the fight.

deed.text: Damage his allies deal from more than 3 hexes away

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 4 (rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-4c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Singing Arrows
apexes.title: the bell in every arrow
apexes.fantasy: Every shot rings out with his note.

vowed.taste: Every 5th basic attack hit by a ranged ally carries a Toll: extra damage of 10% of his MGK.

passives.name: Singing Arrows
passives.text: Every 5th basic attack hit by a ranged ally carries his Toll.

apex.text: Every basic attack hit by a ranged ally carries a Toll of 20% of his MGK and gives him 2 mana. Each carried Toll makes the next on that enemy 5% stronger, until it falls. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

passives.name: Singing Arrows
passives.text: Every basic attack hit by a ranged ally carries his Toll and gives him mana.

passives.name: Rising Pitch
passives.text: His hits on an enemy deal more for each Toll carried to it.

_note: The Mark maker (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8e, path 3; phase 8 part 4, 8d-4b). First numbers.
name: Bellwarden
title: the bell that names the dead
fantasy: The bell names who dies next.
placement: Within 3 hexes of the enemies his team wants dead first.

vowed.taste: Toll the Hour: every 4th Toll Marks its target for 2s.

passives.name: Toll the Hour
passives.text: Every 4th Toll Marks its target for a while.

transformed.text: Toll the Hour: every Toll Marks its target for 3s, and enemies he Marks take more damage. Death Knell replaces Peal: it Marks his target and every enemy within 3 hexes of it for 5s. Peal becomes a habit, every 8th Toll. His MGK and HP rise.

basic_attack.name: Toll
basic_attack.text: A ringing note at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes. Where most of his mana comes from.

signature.name: Death Knell
signature.text: The bell names the dead: his target and every enemy within 3 hexes of it are Marked for a long while.

passives.name: Toll the Hour
passives.text: Every Toll Marks its target for a while, and his Marks bite deeper.

passives.name: Peal
passives.text: A habit: every 8th Toll, the bell peals: the allies within 3 hexes of him attack faster for a while.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 4 (rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-4c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: The Great Bell
apexes.title: the bell the whole field hears
apexes.fantasy: When it tolls, everyone is named.

vowed.taste: Death Knell's Marks last 1s longer.

signature.name: Death Knell
signature.text: The bell names the dead: his target and every enemy within 3 hexes of it are Marked for a long while (longer still).

apex.text: Death Knell Marks every enemy on the field for 5s, and they take 15% more damage from it. Each Death Knell makes every hero deal 5% more damage for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

signature.name: Death Knell
signature.text: The great bell tolls: the nearest enemy within 3 hexes of him and every enemy within 10 hexes of it (anywhere on the field) are Marked for 5s, and his team grows stronger with each toll.

apexes._note: Phase 8 part 4 (rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-4c; apexes.md). Numbers are placeholders scaled to the path's tuned numbers, for the --apexes report and the tuning phase.
apexes.name: Requiem
apexes.title: the toll for the fallen
apexes.fantasy: Every death rings the bell again.

vowed.taste: When a Marked enemy falls, the enemies within 1 hex of it take damage of 20% of his MGK.

passives.name: Requiem
passives.text: When a Marked enemy falls, the bell tolls for the enemies within 1 hex of it.

apex.text: When a Marked enemy falls, the enemies within 2 hexes of it take damage of 100% of his MGK and are Marked. Each toll makes the later ones 15% stronger for the rest of the fight. The apex also gives +15% HP, ATK, and MGK.

passives.name: Requiem
passives.text: When a Marked enemy falls, the bell tolls for the enemies within 2 hexes of it, Marking them, louder each time.
